description_sq:
SHitet vile ne mullet
Ne nje zone te qete , ajer te paster dhe te qete si dhe me gjelberim
Vila ka nje siperfaqe te konsiderueshme oborri si dhe vendin dhe tubacionet per vendosjen e pishines.
Vila ka nje siperfaqe prej 500 m2 dhe organizohet ne dy kate dhe garazhin si dhe nje magazine te madhe qe lidhet me rrugen kryesore.
Ne katin e pare ka nje sallon spacioz ambient ndjenje dhe kuzhinen, nje dhome gjumi dhe nje tualet.
Ne katin e dyte organizohet nga tre dhoma gjumi te mobiluara ne menyre moderne dhe praktike dhe dy banjo moderne
Dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor
Per nje vizite en prone me kontaktoni
title_en: Villa for sale in Mullet, in a quiet area, with clean and quiet air and greenery
description_en: Villa for sale in Mullet In a quiet area, clean and quiet air as well as with greenery. The villa has a considerable yard area as well as the place and pipes for the installation of the swimming pool. The villa has an area of ​​500 m2 and is organized on two floors and the garage as well as a large warehouse connected to the main road. On the first floor there is a spacious living room and kitchen, a bedroom and a toilet. The second floor consists of three bedrooms furnished in a modern and practical way and two modern bathrooms Regular mortgage documentation For a visit to the property contact me
